thread:
frank: Quick ping  StellarCloud asked to onboard a Seoul (kr-seoul) marketplace SKU backed by Alder GPUs. They've requested entitlement + quota + KMS routing by next Thursday.
anika: do we have SKU name from them? any preference on KMS (BYOK vs RW-managed)?
frank: placeholder SKU STELLAR-KR-A1. Partner prefers BYOK but willing to accept redwood-managed for pilot if we provide an SLA addendum.
jules: ops note: Seoul needs a reserve of 10 Alder-equivalent GPUs, control plane 80 vCPU, and 8TB egress/mo baseline. also want private link to Stellar's SI.
mike_ops: can do quota bump but need confirmed SKU and entitlement form. network will need a peering request and firewall rules.
marketplace-bot: ticket created: MKP-3319 - kr-seoul entitlement + KMS flow (assignee: mike_ops). ETA: 2026-06-02.
anika: legal: prefer BYOK for production. if pilot uses RW-managed keys, add clause: 14.2 key custody and 14.3 key rotation schedule (48h). i'll draft redlines.
jules: ops question - if BYOK, do we require partner to provide a key-access endpoint or a cross-account KMS grant? need clarity to file the entitlement.
frank: partner said cross-account grant is fine but asked for a short onboarding runbook for customers. they want to include a sample grant policy.
mike_ops: i'll draft the grant policy sample and network checklist. can someone confirm whether Stellar expects telemetry hooks for billing?
anika: yes they do. legal flagged telemetry access as read-only and telemetry retention <30d. will add to MOA.
jules: staging request: 10 Alder-eq GPUs, 80 vCPU, 8TB egress, private-link subnet carve, and cross-account KMS grant example. autoscaler min 2 / max 20.
frank: marketing wants co-branded launch but prefers to wait until pilot metrics (latency <120ms p95, < $Y/token) are proven. Stellar ok with pilot-only announcement.
mike_ops: created internal checklist in the ticket and attached a rough timeline: peering (2d), quota approval (1d after submission), KMS policy work (1d).
anika: i'll post MOU redlines today. please vote: reply with "+byok" to insist BYOK for pilot or "+rwmanage" to allow RW-managed keys for pilot only. decision needed by EOD Wed so we can file the marketplace listing window.
jules: +byok (ops prefer less key custody)
frank: +rwmanage (partner time-to-market constraint; will push transition to BYOK by day 30)
mike_ops: +rwmanage (we can support managed for 30d and automate rotation logs)
anika: noted split. i'll escalate to security for final signoff if we go RW-managed.
marketplace-bot: reminder: entitlement sync scheduled 2026-05-29 11:00 KST (calendar invite sent).
frank: i'll intro @stella_pm to this thread and attach the SKU draft. ping if blockers.
